# History rewrite of 15 November 2026

On 15 Nov 2026, before the repository was made public, its history was rewritten with
`git filter-repo --replace-text --replace-message` to replace the names of build-machine accounts
(Modal workspaces and agent accounts) with the neutral labels `ws-1` to `ws-6`, in files and in commit
messages. Nothing else changed: the tree of the last commit before the rewrite (`60e07bde`) and of its
rewritten copy is the same tree, `d8b862152cfbb7a192a99b05504c8eb8337480a3`.

Commits from 10 Nov 2026 on have new ids. The commit after the rewrite translated every commit id the
tree cites (documents, scripts and recorded runs) from the old id to the new one, same length. Three
files keep the old ids because a sha256 elsewhere in the tree pins their bytes:
`e2e/runs/cloud-fork-2/lez-inputs.json`, `e2e/runs/sepolia-live-2/lez-inputs.json` (pinned by the
runs' `params.json`) and `releases/0.1.0-rc.1/MANIFEST.json` (pinned by `SHA256SUMS`). The bench
report `bench/report/20261111T1849Z-333f14d58f95/` keeps its name, which holds the old id of the
commit it measured (now `2684f47a9186`). Use the table
below to translate them, or any old id quoted elsewhere.
